All acceptance criteria for 004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS are fully implemented and validated:
- Core Functionality (detecting missing @story/@req on significant branches) is provided by src/rules/require-branch-annotation.ts together with src/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.ts, and thoroughly covered by tests in tests/rules/require-branch-annotation.test.ts across if/else, switch, try/catch, and loop constructs. - Alternative format support is implemented via getBranchAnnotationInfo, which treats any @supports annotation as satisfying both @story and @req, and validated by multiple [REQ-SUPPORTS-ALTERNATIVE] tests. - Quality Standards are met: the rule uses standard ESLint RuleModule patterns, proper meta/schema/messages, non-throwing configuration validation, and has explicit performance testing on large nested-branch files. - Integration with complex nested structures and formatter-driven layouts is confirmed by nested-branch tests, helper tests for catch and else-if comment positions, and integration tests that verify formatter compatibility. - User experience is addressed via a clear, parameterized error message ("Branch is missing required annotation: {{missing}}.") and informative configuration error messages matched in tests. - Error handling for edge cases (invalid config, nested branches, unavailable helper methods like getCommentsInside, etc.) is implemented and exercised in the helper and rule tests. - Documentation exists at docs/rules/require-branch-annotation.md with behavior description, configuration options, and examples consistent with the story’s requirements.
Given the implemented code, comprehensive targeted tests, performance tests, documentation, and a passing full-test run, this story is considered fully implemented: PASSED.
